title: Oops-all adventures
description: This is another Oops-all modpack oriented on exploration looks and structures
body:
This modpack from my Oops-all modpacks is oriented to exploring adventures and movement adding a ton of visual mods shaders resource packs animations and a lot of new structures all preloaded on one modpack
Note:better use case on high to mid-end systems do not use less than a 6 core 12 thread cpu for better performance.Also rembember to enable the resource packs as desired by going into
options>resource packs. and enable whichever you want and also your shaders by going to
Options>graphics>shaders. and enable whichever fits your style and system.
Dedicated amount of RAM allocated:4gb preferaly 5gb
Have Fun :)
